explication: AssetRipper analyzes Unity game files and can convert their assets into native Unity project format. The principal workflow is to load and classify game files, parse serialized data into asset collections, process asset relationships, and export results. The tree also shows dedicated export paths for models, textures, audio, scripts, and Unity projects, plus dependency-analysis tooling. Several runtime relationships are inferred from the product workflow rather than shown in the sampled excerpts, so those links are marked unverified.
